subject: maths
title: Converting Between Forms
welcome_lead: Fractions, decimals and percentages are three ways to say the same thing. Learn to swap between them.
meta_desc: Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages in this KS3 adventure.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now switch forms with confidence.

concepts.def: Part of a whole, written numerator over denominator.
A number written using place value with a point.
A number out of 100, shown with the % sign.
The top number in a fraction.
The bottom number in a fraction.
Having the same value in different forms.

walkthroughs.body_html: To convert 3/4 to a decimal, divide the numerator by the denominator: 3 ÷ 4 = 0.75.

To convert a decimal to a percentage, multiply by 100.

0.75 × 100 = 75%.
A percentage is 'out of 100'. So 40% = 40/100, which simplifies to 2/5.
